name: G.R.
source:
G.R. consist of two scenarios.

Gattsuman no Shishunki Banbanzai focuses on three girls are being kidnapped by the robot.
SEEKER focuses on a girl named Ikumi who is being trained and involves SM theme.
translation:
《G.R.》包含两个篇章。

《Gattsuman no Shishunki Banbanzai》讲述三名女孩被机器人绑架的故事。
《SEEKER》则聚焦名叫Ikumi的女孩，她正在接受训练，内容涉及SM题材。
